tools.name: studio_status
tools.title: Get the status of the studio
tools.description: Gives the state of the agent server: the profile, the active mod, the revision, the undo and redo steps, the tool groups and the limits. This tool changes nothing. Call it first.

annotations.title: Get the status of the studio

tools.name: list_systems
tools.title: List the star systems
tools.description: Lists the star systems of the profile with their nicknames, names and files. This tool changes nothing. Use the references of the result in the other tools.

text.description: Show only the systems whose nickname or name holds this text, without letter case.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Without it, the list starts at the first row.

limit.description: The most rows of the page. studio_status gives the default and the largest value.

tools.name: get_system
tools.title: Get a star system
tools.description: Gives one star system: its fields, the number of items of each kind, its bases, connections, nebulae, asteroid fields and problems. This tool changes nothing.

system.description: The nickname of the system, for example my_system.

tools.name: list_items
tools.title: List the items of a system
tools.description: Lists the items of one system: objects, zones, lights, nebulae and fields. This tool changes nothing. Use the references of the result in the other tools.

system.description: The nickname of the system, for example my_system.

kinds.description: Show only the items of these kinds.

object_kinds.description: Show only the objects of these kinds. A wreck is an object whose archetype has the type MISSION_SATELLITE.

text.description: Show only the items whose nickname, name or archetype holds this text, without letter case.

point.description: The center of the sphere in meters: X, Y and Z.

radius.description: The radius of the sphere in meters.

near.description: Show only the items in a sphere.

origin.description: Show only the items from this layer: the base data, a lower mod or the active mod.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Without it, the list starts at the first row.

limit.description: The most rows of the page. studio_status gives the default and the largest value.

annotations.title: List the items of a system

tools.name: get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Gives one item by its reference: its fields with their values, origins and problems. A reference of a mission, a cutscene element, a prop group or an asset gives the view of that item. This tool changes nothing.

ref.description: An item reference, for example obj:my_station_1 or sec:DATA\SHIPS\loadouts.ini#Loadout/my_loadout.

include_raw.description: Also give the INI text of the section.

include_used_by.description: Also give the lines that name the item and the files that name it as text.

tools.name: find_references
tools.title: Find the references to an item
tools.description: Finds each line that names an item, also in the mission scripts, and each file that names it as text. Give a reference or a name. This tool changes nothing.

ref.description: An item reference, for example obj:my_station_1 or sec:DATA\SHIPS\loadouts.ini#Loadout/my_loadout.

name.description: A nickname. The tool finds the lines of each data list that name it.

annotations.title: Find the references to an item

tools.name: list_values
tools.title: List the values of a data list
tools.description: Lists the values that a field can take, from one data list, for example the archetypes or the loadouts. The text filter also reads the detail, so the text MISSION_SATELLITE finds the wreck archetypes. This tool changes nothing.

list.description: The id of a data list, for example solar_archetype, loadout or faction. The resource openlancer://catalog/lists has all ids.

text.description: Show only the values whose name, label or detail holds this text, without letter case.

system.description: The nickname of the system of a list of one system, for example the list object_of_system.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Without it, the list starts at the first row.

limit.description: The most rows of the page. studio_status gives the default and the largest value.

annotations.title: List the values of a data list

tools.name: search_assets
tools.title: Search the assets
tools.description: Searches the assets of the Assets panel: archetypes, ships, equipment, models and prop groups. This tool changes nothing.

kind.description: Show only the assets of this kind.

category.description: The id of a category of the Assets panel, for example solars/station. The default is all.

text.description: Show only the rows that hold this text, without letter case.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Without it, the list starts at the first row.

limit.description: The most rows of the page. studio_status gives the default and the largest value.

tools.name: list_prop_groups
tools.title: List the prop groups
tools.description: Lists the prop groups of the mods with their members and problems. This tool changes nothing.

text.description: Show only the groups whose nickname or name holds this text, without letter case.

tools.name: list_missions
tools.title: List the mission scripts
tools.description: Lists the mission scripts: the story slots and the other scripts, with their state in the mod, their counts and their versions. This tool changes nothing.

tools.name: get_mission
tools.title: Get a mission script
tools.description: Gives the summary of one mission script: the start triggers, the acts, the prefab instances, the cast and the problems. This tool changes nothing.

script.description: The reference of the mission script, for example msn:DATA\MISSIONS\M01A\m01a.ini.

level.description: summary gives the summary. triggers also gives each trigger with its condition and its actions.

include_lines.description: Also give the raw values of each line by their position.

tools.name: get_trigger
tools.title: Get a mission trigger
tools.description: Gives one trigger: the sentence of its condition, its actions with plain names and labeled values, its links in and out, and its problems. This tool changes nothing.

ref.description: The reference of the trigger, for example trg:DATA\MISSIONS\M01A\m01a.ini#my_trigger.

include_lines.description: Also give the raw values of each line by their position.

tools.name: describe_mission_name
tools.title: Describe a condition or an action
tools.description: Gives the plain name, the group, the values and the OpenLancer coverage of one condition, action or order of the mission scripts. This tool changes nothing.

key.description: The key, for example Cnd_Timer or Act_ActTrig.

annotations.title: Describe a condition or an action

tools.name: list_cutscenes
tools.title: List the cutscenes
tools.description: Lists the cutscene scripts with their folder group, the layer that gives them and their duration. This tool changes nothing.

category.description: Show only the cutscenes of this folder group.

text.description: Show only the cutscenes whose path holds this text, without letter case.

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page. Without it, the list starts at the first row.

limit.description: The most rows of the page. studio_status gives the default and the largest value.

tools.name: get_cutscene
tools.title: Get a cutscene
tools.description: Gives one cutscene script: its duration, its entities, its events with their times and targets, and its errors. This tool changes nothing.

ref.description: The reference of the cutscene, for example thn:DATA\MODS\my_mod\CUTSCENES\my_scene.thn.

tools.name: get_raw_ini
tools.title: Get the raw INI text
tools.description: Gives the INI text of a section or of a whole file of the edit view, with the problems of each line. Give a reference or a file. This tool changes nothing.

ref.description: The reference of a section, for example obj:my_station_1.

file.description: The install path of an INI file, for example DATA\SHIPS\loadouts.ini.

tools.name: check
tools.title: Check the data
tools.description: Runs the checks of the editor and gives the problems with their counts. A problem is data, not a tool error. This tool changes nothing.

scope.description: all gives the errors that stop a save of the active mod. item, mission and cutscene give the problems of the item of ref.

ref.description: The reference of the item of the scope item, mission or cutscene.

target.description: Merge all mods of the profile on the files of this retail game, then give the problems. This check reads the saved files only.

include_base_game.description: Also give the problems and the messages that the base game gives without mods.

tools.name: get_console
tools.title: Read the Console
tools.description: Gives the newest entries of the Console of the editor. This tool changes nothing. Only the editor host has a Console.

source.description: Show only the entries of this source, for example Editor or Agent.

include_base_game.description: Also give the entries that the base game gives without mods.

since.description: Give only the entries after this sequence number.

limit.description: The most rows of the page. studio_status gives the default and the largest value.
